phase_policies.applies_when: At around 180 seconds, heavy economy and tech investment, moderate production, opponent ground posture with Marines/Marauders or possible Reaper opening.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have more information about the opponent's build or when ready to expand.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech, maintain defensive readiness, adapt to Reaper if seen.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and tech, prepare ground army, defend against early Reaper harassment.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Tech/Economy Foundation
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-commit to defense at the expense of economy or neglect scouting for tech switches or all-ins.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 240-360 seconds, heavy economy and tech investment, moderate production, opponent ground posture with possible early pressure.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a clear read on opponent's tech or army composition, or when ready to transition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech, strengthen ground, stay safe against early pressure.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and tech, strengthen ground army, maintain defensive readiness.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Tech/Economy Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect air defense or over-extend army without proper scouting.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 540-600 seconds, heavy production and tech, ground army with Stalkers, Warp Prisms, Observers, Immortals, opponent heavy ground with Marines/Marauders.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have information on opponent's tech path or when ready to push or expand further.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground army, increase production, maintain defense.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army, increase production, maintain defensive awareness.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army Strengthening
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect scouting for tech switches or all-ins while focusing on army.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 600-720 seconds, heavy ground army with Stalkers, Warp Prisms, Observers, Immortals, opponent ground with Marines, Reapers, Medivacs, Widow Mines.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a clear read on opponent's tech or when ready to take a decisive engagement.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Consolidate ground army, increase production, maintain defense.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army, increase production, maintain defensive awareness.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Ground Army Consolidation
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect detection or scouting for tech switches or all-ins.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
